agents.name: Orchestrator
agents.role: LangGraph state machine: runs attempts, routes critic feedback back to the investigator, stops at 3 attempts or the run's time budget

agents.name: Investigator
agents.role: Plans the data it needs, asks the Data Agent in plain language, writes evidence-backed findings under the reconciliation business rules

agents.name: Data Agent
agents.role: Turns requests into read-only SQL over the Zetaris USL table and returns the raw rows unchanged

agents.name: World Model (Meterless engine)
agents.role: Per-run register of every Zetaris row, derived link, finding and verdict, with provenance and an audit log

agents.name: Critic (code checks)
agents.role: Verifies every evidence item against the register; on failure sends concrete fixes back and skips the LLM critic

agents.name: Critic (LLM)
agents.role: Judges logic, candidate vs confirmed, replacement vs duplicate and coverage; ACCEPT or RETRY
